policy.presentation: One style entry for matching designs; select a source-backed Men or Women cut on the product page.
policy.purchase: One selected fit and one selected color. It does not grant both fits or all colors.
policy.identity: Original fit-specific product/SKU and color concept IDs remain unchanged. A fit switch selects a different item and its own colors, bag, listings and market.
policy.tokens: Future approved fit+color editions remain distinct; each issued ERC-721 copy has its own token ID. No token IDs or mint rights are assigned here.
policy.shared: Single shared accessories are not duplicated into male/female stock. Only explicit source compatibility qualifies for both fit filters.
policy.unknown: Unconfirmed items remain in All fits. No inference from suffix, model appearance, family name or default Unisex label.
policy.supply: Grouping is presentation only. Existing per-SKU supply and pricing proposals are preserved; no extra stock or approved caps created.
policy.colors: Nine visual concepts per retained fit-specific SKU. Matching colors across fits require separate approval; do not copy an index or assume equal shaders.

families.name: Undertow Ledger
families.basis: Matching utility trouser design and complete three-component assembly across explicit Male and Female source directories. Both sets have component triangle counts 21716, 5544, 7480.
families.caution: BTWR_001_A and BTWR_001_B omit components 3 and 2+3 respectively. They are configuration variants, not alternate fits, and must not silently inherit the full female assembly.

families.name: Common Ground
families.basis: Matching five-pocket technical trouser silhouette with the same panel arrangements for the base and A artwork families. Explicit Female mesh is reused for its two authored material appearances; all fits have 23590 triangles.
families.caution: A is an artwork/material distinction here, not a female suffix. Existing source aliases and native material overrides must be retained; do not collapse the two artworks merely because the female mesh is shared.

families.name: Common Ground / 02
families.basis: Matching five-pocket technical trouser silhouette with the same panel arrangements for the base and A artwork families. Explicit Female mesh is reused for its two authored material appearances; all fits have 23590 triangles.
families.caution: A is an artwork/material distinction here, not a female suffix. Existing source aliases and native material overrides must be retained; do not collapse the two artworks merely because the female mesh is shared.

families.name: Wrong Exit
families.basis: Matching gathered-waist/cuff jogger design in explicit Male/Female meshes; 15126 triangles per source. Base and A source artwork match corresponding female thumbnails.
families.caution: Base/A artwork and each fit remain separately identified even if displayed on one style page.

families.name: Wrong Exit / 02
families.basis: Matching gathered-waist/cuff jogger design in explicit Male/Female meshes; 15126 triangles per source. Base and A source artwork match corresponding female thumbnails.
families.caution: Base/A artwork and each fit remain separately identified even if displayed on one style page.

families.name: Marble Debt
families.basis: Matching strapped high-top footwear construction in explicit Male/Female source meshes, both 15598 vertices and 29278 triangles.
families.caution: Native source material bindings differ (MI_SUIT_003 versus MI_SUIT_002). Shared footwear design is supported; exact finish equivalence must not be inferred.

families.name: Borrowed Body
families.basis: Matching first suit design with female-shaped torso/hip fit; explicit Male/Female meshes each 16955 vertices and 32968 triangles.
families.caution: Separate fit meshes are native render bindings, not proof that an existing NFT grants both fits. Current suit-only product previews intentionally exclude gloves and footwear.

families.name: Exit Velocity
families.basis: Matching second suit design in explicit Male/Female sources, each 18085 vertices and 35932 triangles.
families.caution: Keep SUIT_002 distinct from SUIT_003/004: equal counts across those families do not establish the same design.

families.name: Duplicate Citizen
families.basis: Matching third suit design in explicit Male/Female sources, each 18085 vertices and 35932 triangles.
families.caution: Keep SUIT_003 distinct from the other suit families; original paneling/collar and authored material design differ.

families.name: Permanent Guest
families.basis: Matching fourth suit design including the reinforced knee/panel treatment in explicit Male/Female sources, each 18085 vertices and 35932 triangles.
families.caution: Keep SUIT_004 distinct from SUIT_002/003 despite equal mesh counts.

keepSeparate.reason: Scoop-neck and V-neck crop top designs, distinct silhouettes and panels.
Different suit designs; only corresponding male/female sources within each family are pairing candidates.
Utility cargo, five-pocket technical, slim rolled-cuff and jogger constructions differ.
Complete versus reduced component configurations; not a fit axis.

conditionalFamilies.decision: Do not automatically merge these finished designs. Confirm whether the desired shared style includes these distinct artwork editions or requires genuinely matched fit+color images.
